methods.summary: Weak to melee, primarily crush; demonic so Arclight/Emberlight apply (set to stab). Twisted bow is extremely effective ranged.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task

methods.label: Melee kill and lava pools
methods.summary: Use melee or demonbane weapons while moving away from lava pools and keeping Cerberus in a stable position.
prayers: Protect from Magic or flicked protections
steps: Enter with 91 Slayer and a hellhound task.
Use strong melee weapons, prioritising demonbane where appropriate.
Move away when lava pools spawn under or near the player.
Keep enough prayer for ghost phases instead of spending every point on DPS prayers.
risks: Low prayer before ghosts can force heavy damage or supply loss.

methods.label: Summoned souls prayer sequence
methods.summary: React to Cerberus ghosts by matching their magic, ranged, and melee hits in order.
requiredOrKeyItems: Audio or visual attention for ghosts
steps: Watch the order of the summoned souls as they approach.
Switch protection prayers to match each incoming ghost attack.
Restore prayer before the sequence if needed.
Resume melee DPS after the final ghost resolves.
risks: Missing ghost prayers causes high damage and prayer drain.
Trying to ignore ghosts is expensive and inconsistent.
